# One public-domain lunar frame

`PIA00302-clementine-nearside.jpg` is the NASA/JPL/USGS Clementine
orthographic nearside view of the Moon (JPL Photojournal PIA00302, 1,719 by
1,719 pixels, 8-bit grayscale, 265,438 bytes). It is the fixture for the
authentic-data leg of the image-measurement gate (`IMAGE_MEASUREMENT_GATE.md`,
Prompt 178), which Carl permitted on 2026-10-22.

Where it came from, its credit and licence statement, its byte count and its
SHA-256 are in `provenance.json`. The file is the server's bytes unchanged. It
is a mosaic, not one exposure, and has no calibration documentation: it is a
display image used for decode, draw and repeatability, never for a calibrated
measurement. It is outside every route and precache.
